fields.evidence: Arena-placement owner byte +1 is copied to battle object +0x06 and used with Gate-slot byte +0 to resolve active Gate ID at +0x04.

mutations: Battle construction derives and stores the owner participant index.

fields.reset: The next constructor clears and rederives the field; destruction ends validity without transferring ownership.
